blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said that some acquisitions under the $2-billion military financing package of the security road map are “not freely sold in other countries.” “Yung [The] two billion is financing for capabilities acquisitions under the security sector road map and some of those are not freely sold in other countries,” Teodoro told reporters at Camp Aguinaldo on Tuesday. “These items that we selected are very hard to get… We’re going to buy it—the fact is they don’t sell it to others,” said Teodoro.
